author: sumedha raghu
message:
Namaskaram,
I came across Prapatti Online 
recently and wanted to say what a remarkable resource it is — the breadth of stotras across so many scripts and languages is truly invaluable for the Srivaishnava community.

I am a software infrastructure engineer with experience in cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and web performance, and I would love to volunteer my time to help modernize the site's technical foundation. Here is what I had in mind:

1. Static Site Migration — The site is currently PHP-rendered, which means every page load hits a server. I can help migrate it to a static site generator (such as Hugo), which would make pages load significantly faster, reduce hosting costs, and eliminate server maintenance overhead entirely.

2. CDN & Global Performance — Serving assets through a CDN (such as Cloudflare, which has a free tier) would make the site faster for visitors across India, the US, and everywhere else the community is spread.

3. Search — With hundreds of stotras, a simple search bar would make the content far more accessible, especially for users who know the name of a stotra but are unsure where to find it.

4. Script/Language Switcher — A prominent language selector so visitors can immediately read in their preferred script (Tamil, Telugu, Devanagari, etc.) without having to scroll through all versions.

5. PWA / Offline Support — Many devotees recite stotras in spaces without reliable internet. A lightweight offline mode would let frequently visited pages load without a connection.

I want to be clear that this is offered entirely as seva — no cost, no obligation. I have deep respect for the work that has gone into this archive and would only proceed with your guidance and at your pace.

If you are open to a conversation, I would be happy to share more details or a simple proposal document.

Adiyen,
